name: OTTO System
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-contrib
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.0 --activate
pnpm install
pnpm --filter @otto/shared build
pnpm db:generate

terminals.name: otto
terminals.description: Starts PostgreSQL, migrates/seeds the database, then runs the NestJS API (4000) and Vite web app (5173).
